elements.text: ECDAT — Engineering Completion Report
PS 26164 · NTRO · Enterprise Cryptographic Discovery & Analysis Tool. MVP complete: 37/37 acceptance tests pass; CycloneDX 1.6 CBOM validates against the official schema.
1. What was built (vertical slice)
• Source scanner: Python + Java crypto API detection (RSA, ECDSA/DSA, ECDH/X25519, AES, SHA-256/384/512, MD5, SHA-1, DES/3DES).
• Dependency scanner: requirements.txt + pom.xml → library/version crypto assets.
• Certificate scanner: PEM/DER X.509 metadata (subject, issuer, key size, validity).
• Config scanner: nginx/TLS configs → TLS versions, cipher suites, DH params.
• Normalisation → unified CryptoAsset model with evidence (file, line, rule, confidence).
• Quantum classification (SHOR_BROKEN / GROVER_WEAKENED / QUANTUM_SAFE / CLASSICALLY_BROKEN) + HNDL/TNFL.
• Mosca X + Y > Z engine with scenario-year selector (2030/2035/2040).
• Transparent 0–100 risk score + deterministic NIST FIPS 203/204/205 recommendations.
• CycloneDX 1.6 CBOM generation + schema validation.
• 6-page Streamlit dashboard (Dashboard / New Scan / Inventory / Asset Detail / Mosca / Reports).
2. Measured results (controlled corpus)
3. Real open-source target (CPython 3.11 stdlib)

Note: the high RSA count on the real target reflects the broad LOW-confidence 'RSA' heuristic matching common stdlib/doc text; confidence is reported honestly per asset. Compiled binary wheels (e.g. pyca/cryptography .pyd) return 0 findings as expected — source scanning targets plain-text source.
4. Acceptance gates

[x] Python + Java discovery   [x] Evidence   [x] Dependency versions   [x] Certificate metadata   [x] Quantum classification   [x] HNDL/TNFL   [x] Type/lifetime/criticality   [x] Mosca X+Y>Z   [x] Risk score   [x] PQC recommendation   [x] CycloneDX 1.6 CBOM   [x] CBOM validation PASS   [x] Dashboard runs cleanly   [x] 37/37 tests   [x] Real metrics   [x] 6-slide deck
5. How to run
Launch app: python run.py   (or: streamlit run app/ui/dashboard.py)
Run tests:  python -m pytest tests/ -q
Controlled corpus: test_corpus/  ·  Real demo target: test-data/sample-project/
CBOM: output/cbom/ECDAT_controlled_corpus_cbom.json  ·  Deck: output/ECDAT_SIH_6Slide.pptx  ·  Metrics: output/metrics.json
6. Limitations & roadmap
• Source scanning is regex/rule-based; heuristic LOW-confidence matches possible.
• Compiled binaries / OCI layers not analysed (ROADMAP).
• Live TLS endpoint probe / SSH probe = OPTIONAL (implemented on request).
• Cloud inventory (AWS/Azure/GCP), HSM enumeration, C/C++/Go/Rust = ROADMAP.
• No private key material is ever stored or displayed (verified by test).
